repos.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
repos.summary_zh: CS-Notes 是专为技术面试打造的全栈知识体系，系统整合算法（LeetCode、剑指Offer 题解）、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库原理、Java 核心技术（并发、JVM）及大规模系统设计等核心内容。以实战为导向，深度结合理论与实践，覆盖从基础到架构的完整技能树，是程序员求职面试的高效复习指南。
repos.summary_en: CS-Notes is a systematic knowledge repository specifically designed for technical interview preparation, encompassing core CS fundamentals including algorithms (LeetCode, 剑指Offer solutions), operating systems, computer networks, database principles, Java internals (concurrency, JVM, I/O), and large-scale system design. It bridges theory with hands-on practice through extensive coding problems and architectural case studies, offering a complete skill development path from basic concepts to advanced engineering architecture for software engineers.

repos.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
repos.summary_zh: DeerFlow 是字节跳动开源的超级智能体框架，通过协调子智能体、记忆系统和沙箱环境，处理分钟级到小时级的复杂研究与创作任务。其核心在于可扩展技能体系与上下文工程，支持长期记忆持久化与文件系统操作，为构建自主智能体应用提供生产级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: DeerFlow is an open-source SuperAgent harness by Bytedance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle complex research, coding, and creative tasks spanning minutes to hours. Featuring extensible skills, context engineering, and long-term memory persistence, it provides production-grade infrastructure for building autonomous agent applications.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: OpenViking是专为AI Agent设计的开源上下文数据库，创新性地采用文件系统范式统一管理记忆、资源与技能，解决碎片化问题。核心亮点包括：L0/L1/L2分层加载大幅降低token成本；目录递归检索结合语义搜索提升精度；检索轨迹可视化打破RAG黑盒；自动会话管理实现上下文自演进。
repos.summary_en: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed for AI Agents. It unifies memory, resources, and skills via a filesystem paradigm. Key features include tiered loading (L0/L1/L2) to reduce token consumption, directory-recursive retrieval for improved precision, visualized retrieval trajectories for full observability, and automatic session management enabling self-evolving, adaptive context.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯开源的WeKnora是LLM驱动的文档智能框架，基于RAG范式实现深度文档理解与语义检索。采用模块化架构，支持多模态预处理、父-子分块、智能检索与重排序，可处理复杂异构文档。集成Milvus向量数据库，提供上下文感知的高质量问答，适用于企业知识库、智能客服等场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora, Tencent's open-source LLM-powered framework, enables deep document understanding and semantic retrieval via RAG paradigm. Its modular architecture supports multimodal preprocessing, hierarchical parent-child chunking, intelligent retrieval, and reranking for complex heterogeneous documents. Integrated with Milvus vector database, it delivers context-aware answers for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service.

repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
repos.summary_en: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

repos.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
repos.summary_zh: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
repos.summary_en: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.summary_zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
repos.summary_en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
repos.summary_en: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: AI 视频笔记生成工具 让 AI 为你的视频做笔记
repos.summary_zh: BiliNote 是一款开源的 AI 视频笔记生成工具，支持 B 站、YouTube、抖音等多平台视频。通过 Fast-Whisper 实现本地音频转写，结合 GPT 大模型（OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen）自动生成结构化 Markdown 笔记。支持自动截图、视频跳转、多风格摘要，可本地部署保障隐私，适合学习、知识管理与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: BiliNote is an open-source AI-powered video note-taking tool supporting Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and more. It leverages Fast-Whisper for local audio transcription and GPT models (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen) to automatically generate structured Markdown notes. Features include auto-screenshots, video timestamp links, customizable summary styles, and local deployment for privacy protection. Ideal for learning, knowledge management, and content creation workflows with GPU acceleration support.

repos.description: 📃 A better UX for chat, writing content, and coding with LLMs.
repos.summary_zh: Open Canvas 是 LangChain 开源的 AI 文档协作平台，基于 LangGraph 构建多智能体系统。核心亮点包括：内置反思智能体实现跨会话记忆，支持从现有文档开始而非强制聊天，提供可定制快捷操作和版本回溯，同时支持代码与 Markdown 实时渲染编辑。作为 OpenAI Canvas 的开源替代方案，它通过持久化用户风格规则实现个性化体验，适用于写作、编程等场景。
repos.summary_en: Open Canvas is LangChain's open-source AI document collaboration platform built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture. Key innovations include: built-in reflection agents with cross-session memory, starting from existing documents instead of chat-only, customizable quick actions, artifact versioning, and live code/Markdown editing. As an open alternative to OpenAI Canvas, it personalizes experiences by persisting user style rules and insights, ideal for writing, coding, and collaborative content creation.

repos.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
repos.summary_zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
repos.summary_en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

repos.description: OpenKB: Open LLM Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: OpenKB是开源CLI的LLM知识库系统，通过编译文档构建结构化wiki，支持PageIndex无向量长文档检索与推理。知识一次性持久化积累，自动生成摘要、概念页与交叉引用，优于传统RAG每次重算。兼容多LLM、多模态输入及Skill Factory蒸馏专家技能。适用于知识管理、学术研究与智能体构建场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that uses LLMs to compile raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki-style knowledge base. Powered by PageIndex for vectorless long-document retrieval and reasoning, it compiles knowledge once into a persistent wiki with automatic summaries, concepts, and cross-references—unlike traditional RAG. Supports multi-LLM via LiteLLM, multi-modality, query/chat, and Skill Factory for portable expert skills. Ideal for knowledge management, research, and AI agent development.

repos.summary_zh: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

repos.description: :earth_americas: machine learning tutorials (mainly in Python3)
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库是系统性的机器学习教程集合，以Jupyter Notebook形式提供。内容涵盖深度学习、强化学习、时间序列等多个领域，核心特色在于平衡数学原理与工程实践：既包含NumPy/SciPy等科学计算栈的从零实现，也演示TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn等主流框架的工业级应用。适合希望深入理解算法底层并掌握实际部署技能的学习者。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive collection of machine learning tutorials in Jupyter Notebook format. It covers diverse topics including deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, and recommendation systems. The key feature is balancing mathematical theory with hands-on implementation—both from scratch using Python's scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, PySpark) and with popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Hugging Face. It serves as an educational resource for learners seeking deep algorithmic understanding alongside practical engineering skills in model deployment and A/B testing.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Digital Garden 插件将 Obsidian 知识库转化为精美数字花园网站。支持选择性发布（仅 dg-publish: true 笔记公开），保护隐私。全面兼容 Dataview、Canvas、Excalidraw、Mermaid 等功能，提供搜索、图谱、反向链接导航及主题/CSS 定制。基于 Eleventy 静态生成，通过 Vercel/Netlify 一键部署或 Forestry 托管，实现零成本、完全可控的知识分享与持续迭代。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Digital Garden plugin transforms Obsidian vaults into beautiful, customizable digital garden websites. It enables selective publishing via 'dg-publish: true' frontmatter for privacy control. It supports extensive Obsidian features including Dataview queries, Canvas, Excalidraw, Mermaid diagrams, plus advanced navigation like search, graphs, and backlinks. Customization includes themes, CSS variables, and custom components. Powered by Eleventy for static sites, it offers seamless deployment to Vercel/Netlify or managed hosting via Forestry.md, giving users full ownership of their evolving knowledge base.

repos.description: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
repos.summary_en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

repos.description: Fractal Graph-of-Thought. Rhizomatic Mind-Mapping for Ai-Agents, Web-Links, Notes, and Code.
repos.summary_zh: Neurite 采用分形几何与图论构建无限维思维导图，融合AI代理与多模态节点（代码/链接/笔记）。支持多代理协同与神经网络API，为创意协作与知识管理提供非线性、自相似的可视化工作空间。
repos.summary_en: Neurite is an open-source fractal-based mind-mapping platform that merges chaos theory with graph theory to create an infinite-dimensional digital workspace. It interconnects AI agents, code snippets, notes, and web links as nodes in a rhizomatic structure. Key features include multi-agent UI collaboration, FractalGPT integration, a Neural API, and synchronized knowledge management. The system enables non-linear creative thinking by revealing hidden patterns through self-similar fractal geometries, transforming how complex information is organized and visualized.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: A lightweight knowledge base for people and agents, with ultra fast indexing and most precise retrieval.
repos.summary_zh: SAG-Wiki 是一款轻量级本地知识库，为个人与 AI 智能体提供超快索引和精确检索。基于 Rust/Tauri 构建，无需 LLM 调用即可索引百万字符约 200ms，采用自研 SAG2 证据检索技术，支持跨语言问答、全局快捷键快速搜索及多种文档格式，答案可溯源至原文。
repos.summary_en: SAG-Wiki is a lightweight local knowledge base for humans and AI agents, offering ultra-fast indexing and precise retrieval. Built with Rust/Tauri, it indexes a million characters in ~200ms without LLM calls. Its original SAG2 evidence retrieval outperforms RAG/GraphRAG, supports cross-language Q&A, global quick search, and multiple document formats with traceable answers.

repos.description: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。
repos.summary_zh: 精选面向长期AI伴侣关系的开源软件、基础设施与社区，覆盖客户端、桌宠、主动心跳、长期记忆、情感状态、语音视觉具身与数据主权等模块，强调脱离官端自主运行，助力构建有记忆、主动性与持续性的人机恋体验。
repos.summary_en: Curated open-source list of software, infrastructure and communities for long-term AI companion relationships. Covers clients, desktop pets, proactive messaging, memory systems, emotion state, voice/visual embodiment and data ownership, enabling independent, memory-rich and proactive companions beyond official platforms.

repos.summary_zh: 翼龙面板Node.js部署环境，支持Argo双模隧道（QUIC/HTTP2）、TUIC、Hysteria2及VLESS-Reality等代理协议。针对64MB低内存平台深度优化，内置6级自适应匹配与主动内存回收机制，兼容多个免费托管平台，适用于网络运维与抗封锁场景。
repos.summary_en: Node.js deployment environment for Yilong Panel supporting Argo dual-mode tunnels (QUIC/HTTP2), TUIC, Hysteria2, and VLESS-Reality proxy protocols. Deeply optimized for 64MB low-memory platforms with 6-level adaptive matching and active memory reclamation, compatible with multiple free hosting services for network operations and anti-blocking.

repos.description: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
repos.summary_zh: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
repos.summary_en: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

repos.description: A automatic pipeline that processing obsidian vault by llm from pinbord, obsidian Clipper etc.
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Vault Pipeline 是一个基于 Obsidian 的可审计知识状态运行时系统，利用 LLM 实现从 Pinboard、Obsidian Clipper 等来源的自动捕获、编译与复用。核心流程 Capture → Compile → Reuse，内置 Ingest 至 Derive 六阶段流水线，将原始材料转化为证据链、关系、图谱等结构化知识。提供 ovp CLI、autopilot 模式及本地 UI，支持 research-tech 等领域包扩展。亮点在于状态模型分离（Source/Candidate/Canonical/Projection/Governance）、证据可追溯与 Pack API 可扩展性，适用于个人知识管理与研究自动化。
repos.summary_en: Obsidian Vault Pipeline is an auditable knowledge state runtime for Obsidian vaults that uses LLMs to automatically capture, compile, and reuse knowledge from sources like Pinboard and Obsidian Clipper. It follows the Capture → Compile → Reuse narrative with a six-stage pipeline (Ingest to Derive), transforming raw inputs into evidence chains, relations, contradictions, and graphs. Features CLI tools (ovp --full, autopilot), local UI, domain packs like research-tech, and a strict state model (Sources, Candidates, Canonical State, Projections, Governance). Highlights include traceable evidence, rebuildable projections, and extensible Pack API for scalable PKM and research workflows.

repos.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。
repos.summary_zh: GitHubStarsIndex 自动化抓取 GitHub Star 仓库，调用 AI 生成智能摘要与技术标签。支持增量更新、高并发处理，输出 Markdown 和交互式 HTML 页面，可无缝同步至 Obsidian 知识库或 GitHub Pages，实现个人技术资产的智能化管理与高效检索。
repos.summary_en: GitHubStarsIndex automates fetching GitHub starred repositories and generates AI-powered summaries with technical tags. Supporting incremental updates, concurrent processing, and Jinja2 templating, it outputs structured Markdown and interactive HTML pages with search functionality. The tool seamlessly syncs to Obsidian vaults or deploys to GitHub Pages with multilingual support, transforming scattered stars into a searchable, organized technical knowledge base for efficient asset management.
